problem.summary: 视觉问答（VQA）模型倾向于利用语言先验（language priors）而非真正的视觉理解来回答问题，导致模型性能虚高，无法真正理解图像内容。

motivation.summary: 现有VQA数据集存在严重的语言偏见，例如对于以'Do you see a...'开头的问题，盲目回答'yes'即可达到87%的准确率。这阻碍了计算机视觉在多模态AI中的进步。

core_idea.summary: 通过构建平衡的VQA数据集（VQA v2.0），为每个问题收集一对相似但答案不同的图像，以削弱语言先验的影响，迫使模型依赖视觉理解。

method.summary: 1. 设计新的数据收集接口，通过Amazon Mechanical Turk为VQA数据集中的每个问题收集互补图像。2. 在平衡数据集上评估现有VQA模型。3. 提出一个可解释模型，不仅能回答问题，还能通过反例图像解释其答案。

experiments.summary: 在原始不平衡VQA数据集和新的平衡VQA数据集上评估了多个SOTA VQA模型（如d-LSTM+n-I, HieCoAtt, MCB）。结果表明，模型在平衡数据集上性能显著下降，证实了语言偏见的存在。在平衡数据集上训练后，模型性能有所提升。

claims.claim: 现有VQA模型严重依赖语言先验，而非视觉理解。
平衡的VQA数据集能更公平地评估模型的视觉理解能力。
在平衡数据集上训练可以提升模型的视觉理解能力。
提出的可解释模型能通过反例图像提供有意义的解释。

limitations.limitation: 1. 数据收集过程可能仍存在一些偏见（例如，约9%的问题在互补图像上答案相同）。2. 平衡数据集并非完美平衡，但比原始数据集显著更平衡。3. 可解释模型的反例解释质量仍有提升空间。

terms.definition: 视觉问答，指给定一张图像和一个关于该图像的自然语言问题，模型需要生成一个自然语言答案的任务。
语言先验，指模型利用问题文本中的统计规律（而非图像内容）来预测答案的倾向。例如，对于'Is there a...'类型的问题，模型可能倾向于回答'yes'。
平衡数据集，指通过数据收集方法，使得每个问题都有多个可能答案，且答案分布更均匀的数据集，以减少语言偏见。
互补图像，指对于同一个问题，一对相似但导致不同答案的图像。
反例解释，指模型在给出答案后，提供一个与原始图像相似但答案不同的图像，以解释其决策。
成对铰链排序损失，一种用于排序任务的损失函数，鼓励正确项的得分高于错误项至少一个间隔M。

metadata.title: Making the V in VQA Matter: Elevating the Role of Image Understanding in Visual Question Answering
metadata.paper_type: Computer Vision / Pose Estimation / Vision-Language / VQA / Computer Vision / Top-cited Computer Vision paper
metadata.abstract: The problem of visual question answering (VQA) is of significant importance both as a challenging research question and for the rich set of applications it enables. In this context, however, inherent structure in our world and bias in our language tend to be a simpler signal for learning than visual modalities, resulting in VQA models that ignore visual information, leading to an inflated sense of their capability. We propose to counter these language priors for the task of VQA and make vision (the V in VQA) matter! Specifically, we balance the popular VQA dataset (Antol et al., in: ICCV, 2015) by collecting complementary images such that every question in our balanced dataset is associated with not just a single image, but rather a pair of similar images that result in two different answers to the question. Our dataset is by construction more balanced than the original VQA dataset and has approximately twice the number of image-question pairs. Our complete balanced dataset is publicly available at http://visualqa.org/ as part of the 2nd iteration of the VQA Dataset and Challenge (VQA v2.0). We further benchmark a number of state-of-art VQA models on our balanced dataset. All models perform significantly worse on our balanced dataset, suggesting that these models have indeed learned to exploit language priors. This finding provides the first concrete empirical evidence for what seems to be a qualitative sense among practitioners. We also present interesting insights from analysis of the participant entries in VQA Challenge 2017, organized by us on the proposed VQA v2.0 dataset. The results of the challenge were announced in the 2nd VQA Challenge Workshop at the IEEE Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR) 2017. Finally, our data collection protocol for identifying complementary images enables us to develop a novel interpretable model, which in addition to providing an answer to the given (image, question) pair, also provides a counter-example based explanation. Specifically, it identifies an image that is similar to the original image, but it believes has a different answer to the same question. This can help in building trust for machines among their users.
